summary_md: **Sam ([@sam_rahmanii](https://x.com/sam_rahmanii/status/2115725341427904761))** open-sources **mort-stack**, four Claude Code skills honed over months: *replicate-ui* rebuilds a page by measuring it into a checklist instead of screenshot diffing (39/39 checks on a GitHub page, and learned to measure the font actually loaded), *run-round* runs multi-agent plan→lanes→verify→repair loops with typed reports and local CI, *handover* writes cold-start docs before context runs out, and *cite-precedent* makes agents copy and cite mature open-source solutions ([GeneralVoritzio/mort-stack](https://github.com/GeneralVoritzio/mort-stack)).
